## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Duplicate adoption output should be fixed: the command renders the new adoption records after the planner has already emitted their messages.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and audit metadata to settings plans. Added tests check audit output suppression and empty-plan metadata; this review read these tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message only once — Calling `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` now emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits it immediately at line 8, then app/cli.py:9 renders the appended adoption record again. — When an incoming setting already exists, duplicate command output makes a single adoption appear to have occurred twice.
